Our story

Meet the owners

Our journey

Two generations.
One promise.

Sai Auto Consultant was founded in 1999 by Jignesh Solanki, a man whose love for vehicles was matched only by his commitment to honest business. Over 25 years, a humble consulting practice grew into a full-service vehicle dealership serving thousands of customers across Surat and South Gujarat.

Today his son Yash Solanki carries the legacy forward, bringing fresh energy, digital-first thinking and the same integrity that defined day one. Together they handle new vehicle sales, pre-owned buying and selling, insurance advisory and RTO documentation.

At Sai Auto Consultant, we don't just sell vehicles. We build relationships.

Est. 1999 · Surat
